title: Roll with cash-poor reserve
description: Roll with cash-poor reserve. Paying consumes too much of the emergency reserve. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: Rolling the dice for a chance to get out of jail!
final_action.private_thought: Cash low (75). Paying 50 fine leaves only 25, limiting future actions. Rolling for doubles costs nothing and may free me without cash loss. If fail, I stay in jail and can try again later, preserving cash for potential house purchases or other opportunities.

breakdown.message: Uses jail as defense rather than voluntarily spending cash.
Preserves the full cash reserve by rolling.
